collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IV (61-80, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager who stacks the baskets by size every evening finds them already stacked by color.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every evening (subject) stacks the village baskets by size, biggest on the bottom, smallest on top, all facing the same way. Tonight (subject.he/she) arrives to find (friend) has already done it, "to help." The baskets are sorted by color.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) thanks (friend) warmly, waits for (friend.him/her) to leave, and then restacks every basket by size. The next evening (subject.he/she) finds them sorted by color again. This goes on for several days. Neither of them ever mentions it. It becomes, without anyone deciding so, a quiet sort of game.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) looks at the stack for a long time. It's wrong. It's also, now (subject.he/she) looks at it properly, rather pretty, like a little sunset made of baskets. (subject.He/She) leaves it. It bothers (subject.him/her) for exactly two days, and then (subject.he/she) stops noticing.
